venue.address: Astra Hall, Old Student Centre, Belfield, Dublin

items.information: This competition is open to everyone. There will be a 100 person competitor limit. You can reserve a spot by registering on this page and paying the registration fee online [here](http://www.ukca.org/dublin-open-2017-payment) before midnight November 26. If we do not reach 100 paid competitors, registration at the door will still be possible.
